title: Guaranteed Resource Cleanup with try ... of ... catch ... after & Boundary Deserialization
solutionExplanation: Uses try...of...catch...after to deserialize safely with [safe] and guarantee resource release in after blocks across all error conditions.

otpDocCards.description: Decodes an external binary into an Erlang term. [safe] prevents DoS from arbitrary atom creation.
otpDocCards.complexityNote: O(N) memory allocation on process heap.

mentalModelCheck.question: What happens to the return value of an `after` block in an Erlang `try ... catch ... after` expression?
mentalModelCheck.codeSnippet:
Result = try
    compute_result()
after
    cleanup_socket(),
    cleaned_up
end.

options.label: The return value of the after block is silently discarded; Result receives the outcome of the try (or catch) block.
options.explanation: Correct! The after block is strictly for side-effects (closing ports, files, sockets). Its return value is ignored by the runtime, ensuring the caller receives the actual computation or error result.

options.label: Result receives the tuple {try_result, after_result}.
options.explanation: Erlang does not bundle the after return value into a tuple.

options.label: The after block return value overrides the try result.
options.explanation: The try result is preserved; after block values are discarded.
